note: Schema metadata only. No row contents, credentials, or secrets. Supabase remains the schema source of truth until a reviewed MySQL migration is approved.

columns.name: pricing_rules
columns.comment: Conditional pricing rules evaluated against submitted service form data.

columns.name: status
columns.check: status::text = ANY (ARRAY['registered'::character varying, 'pending_payment'::character varying, 'checking'::character varying, 'need_documents'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'ready'::character varying, 'completed'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying, 'rejected'::character varying]::text[])) NOT VALI

columns.name: form_id
columns.comment: Exact custom form selected for this order.

columns.name: form_schema_snapshot
columns.comment: Immutable snapshot of the exact form schema used when the order was submitted.

columns.name: form_type
columns.comment: normal = standalone or child form; parent = container/root form

columns.name: parent_form_id
columns.comment: Self-reference to the parent form. NULL for parent and standalone forms.

columns.name: service_id
columns.comment: Service that owns this form hierarchy.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Display order of child forms inside the parent.

columns.name: price
columns.comment: Price for this exact form; child forms may have their own service price.

columns.name: type
columns.check: type::text = ANY (ARRAY['registration'::character varying, 'announcement'::character varying, 'notice'::character varying, 'regulation'::character varying]::text[])

columns.name: method
columns.comment: online = gateway payment; card_to_card = manual bank-card transfer.

columns.name: gateway
columns.comment: Payment provider: zibal, zarinpal, or manual for card-to-card.

columns.name: authority
columns.comment: Gateway-specific payment authority/token, such as Zibal trackId when applicable.

columns.name: transaction_id
columns.comment: Gateway reference/transaction identifier after successful verification.

columns.name: gateway_response
columns.comment: Raw normalized/sanitized gateway response for auditing; never store secrets.

columns.name: receipt_image_url
columns.comment: Storage URL for a user-uploaded card-to-card receipt.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Local customer-facing display name; editable by admins.

columns.name: provider_name
columns.comment: Original service name returned by the external provider (FJPanel).

columns.name: message
columns.check: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM message)) >= 1 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM message)) <= 4000

columns.name: content
columns.check: char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM content)) >= 2 AND char_length(TRIM(BOTH FROM content)) <= 2000
